title: 12 S house- 3 MILES to downtown, charming nbrhd
description:
This home is PERFECT for groups travelling together and want room to spread out and enjoy a large area to gather.  The house is over 2400 square feet and features FOUR bedrooms, FOUR full bathrooms, TWO living spaces, and more!

LOCATION could not be more perfect to enjoy the city- walk to 12th South Avenue shops/restaurants and only THREE MILES TO DOWNTOWN!  Parks, coffee shops, sidewalks, photo ops, restuarants, and easy access to all the fun and energy in the heart of the city

The space
LOCATION could not be more perfect to enjoy the city.  WALK (yes, walk!) to the bustling strip that is 12 South Avenue- restaurants, shops, and the famous "I Believe in Nashville" mural.  Or, walk to the newly developed Franklin Pike (8th Avenue) area.  Take a meandering stroll through the neighborhood and see the historic homes (and maybe spot one of the famous musicians who live in the neighborhood!).  Not only are you in the middle of the hippest area of town, but you are ONLY THREE MILES TO DOWNTOWN.  Catch an easy Uber ride to Broadway for the nightlife and music that Nashville is famous for!

Legally operating Airbnb with city-issued permit so you know you have a safe and secure reservation that won't get cancelled last minute due to city-wide shut-downs of non-permitted short term rentals.

LARGE LIVING AREA
The large living area has an extra large sectional couch along with other seating that can comfortably sit large groups.  The room has a large TV with cable and DVD player for entertainment and for relaxing after a long day of site seeing.  

SECOND LIVING AREA
The front room when you walk into the house is cozy for intimate hangs and gets lots of great sunlight.  Perfect for sipping coffee in the morning or late night talks.

BEDROOMS
Brand new Casper hybrid mattresses and feather soft pillows in all the bedrooms. Sink into luxury!
BEDROOM 1- KING BED (private en suite bathroom)
BEDROOM 2- TWO QUEEN BEDS (private en suite bathroom)
BEDROOM 3- QUEEN BED (hall access to shared full bathroom with tub)
BEDROOM 4- QUEEN BED (hall access to shared full bathroom with tub)
LIVING ROOM- Full size pull out sleeper sofa (close access to full bathroom in the back hall)

UPSTAIRS EN SUITE BATHROOM #1
This newly renovated bathroom has a walk-in shower and large back-lit LED mirror.

UPSTAIRS EN SUITE BATHROOM #2
This bathroom has a large shower with double shower heads and double sinks. 

HALLWAY BATHROOM
This bathroom is in a private hallway between the two downstairs bedrooms.  It has a shower/tub combo.

FOURTH FULL BATHROOM
This bathroom is off of a back hall from the living area (that includes the sleeper sofa).  It has a walk-in shower and plenty of space to get ready for anyone who is looking for extra space beyond the bedrooms' bathrooms.

DINING AREA
This area has banquette seating on one wall to accommodate large groups who all want to sit together to eat.  It is directly off the kitchen, making it very easy for those in the kitchen and open to both living spaces.

THE KITCHEN
The kitchen has been newly remodeled and is small but sufficient for those coming in for a quick stay.  All the amenities and fully stocked.  It is open to the dining area, making cooking fun to be able to interact with the rest of the group while not having "too many cooks in the kitchen."

OUTDOOR SPACE
Has a covered area with a propane grill making it enjoyable rain or shine!  If the weather is beautiful (and it usually is!) then enjoy the outdoor seating under twinkle lights.  The only thing we ask here is to be respectful of the neighbors!

The front door has a keypad, programmed with a unique code for your visit.  This makes entering and leaving the house so easy and no key to worry about!

Guest access
Keypad on the front door programmed to the last 4 digits of renter's phone number
